title: Map of the UK and adjective bank
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: Local area, holiday and travel: town, region and country; holidays (2.3, 2.1)
source: Written for arabic/y10 lesson 36 (Map of the UK and adjective bank (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 36: My town and region: where it is and what it is like. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

head: Arabic
English
rows: my town is in the north of England
in the south / east / west / centre of ...
the capital of Britain is London

parts.text: أَسْكُنُ فِي بِرْمِنْغْهَام، وَهِيَ مَدِينَةٌ كَبِيرَةٌ تَقَعُ فِي وَسَطِ إِنْجِلْتِرَا.
مَدِينَتِي حَدِيثَةٌ وَمُزْدَحِمَةٌ، وَفِيهَا مَسَاجِدُ كَثِيرَةٌ.
الرِّيفُ أَهْدَأُ مِنَ المَدِينَةِ، لٰكِنِّي أُفَضِّلُ المَدِينَةَ لِأَنَّ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ قَرِيبٌ.

blocks.text: Write شَمَال، جَنُوب، شَرْق and غَرْب round the map. Mark your town and write one sentence: تَقَعُ مَدِينَتِي فِي ...

questions.q: Say: Leeds is in the north of England and it is a historic city.
questions.a: تَقَعُ لِيدْز فِي شَمَالِ إِنْجِلْتِرَا، وَهِيَ مَدِينَةٌ تَارِيخِيَّةٌ.

questions.q: Core: Write 80 words (portal response box) describing your town or region: location, three adjectives, places, a comparison with the countryside and your preference.
questions.a: Marked for location phrases, feminine agreement, comparison, preference with reason.

questions.q: Extend: Translate into Arabic: My region is beautiful but the town centre is crowded at the weekend.
questions.a: مِنْطَقَتِي جَمِيلَةٌ لٰكِنَّ وَسَطَ المَدِينَةِ مُزْدَحِمٌ فِي نِهَايَةِ الأُسْبُوعِ.

questions.q: Stretch (Group A): explain why وَسَطَ is accusative in your translation.
questions.a: اِسْمُ لٰكِنَّ مَنْصُوبٌ (the noun after لٰكِنَّ is accusative)
B) مَدِينَتِي هَادِئَةٌ. مَدِينَة is feminine: هَادِئَةٌ. أَهْدَأُ means quieter.

questions.q: 'Is located in' (for a city): A) تَقَعُ فِي B) يَقَعُ فِي
Big question: describe your town in one developed sentence.
questions.a: For example: أَسْكُنُ فِي مَدِينَةٍ هَادِئَةٍ تَقَعُ فِي جَنُوبِ إِنْجِلْتِرَا.
